chapter_note: Classic four-fold cosmological iteration teaching (Father/Land of Light → Cosmos/Sun-Ship → Elements → [extension]). The fourth iteration at i=47-58 is a textbook editorial seam: bridge connective 'Ⲧⲁⲗⲓⲛ ⲁⲛ' (Again, in turn) extends the substrate pattern into the Manichaean Church, identifying Apostle of Light, teachers, elect, virgins, and catechumens. The pattern of three cosmic iterations (Father → cosmos → elements) is complete in itself; the church-iteration is the editorial extension. Editorial fatigue score (+14.5 ecclesial drift in second half) confirms this. Substrate teaching of segments 18-46 is dense and well-preserved.
